description: The fix for global state: an Environment class that each test creates fresh, with its own bindings and an optional parent.

steps.description: This is the fix: an `Environment` class that each test creates fresh. The page says the fix is always the same, create a fresh `Environment()` for each test.
`__init__` gives each environment its own `bindings` dictionary and an optional `parent`, so no two environments share storage.
`extend` creates a child environment, sets one binding in it, and returns the child, leaving the parent unchanged.
`lookup` checks this environment's `bindings` first, then asks the parent, and raises `LangNameError` when the name is in neither.
